thesis_text:
Bottom line: for Deloitte Consulting (Consulting, entry), your odds through the cold application alone are low, but not zero. This read rests on a curated-qualitative record as of 2026-10-12 with no population sample — treat every pattern below as reported, not measured. How Deloitte differs from MBB, stated as a reported norm and grounded in the structural evidence in this record: hiring is decentralized by service line and location into individual postings with role-specific qualifications (one official entry posting lists a 3.2 GPA as preferred, not a hard published cutoff), rather than one national associate class screened on a single summer deadline. That makes the funnel wider in the specific sense that there are more distinct entry doors, more start contexts (commercial consulting, technology implementation, and government delivery work that MBB does not hire undergraduates into in the same way), and more chances across the year - not in the sense that any individual posting is easy. Interviewing still includes both behavioral and case components for consulting roles (case component labeled reported where it rests on secondary guides).

Who gets in (sample N=not available — curated-qualitative record, as of 2026-10-12):
- This CIR is curated-qualitative: no population sample exists for it yet, so there are no percentages to show. What follows is the reported pattern from public sources, labeled as such.
Known biases of this data: Qualification and pay evidence rests heavily on one official posting example, which is a government delivery role and may not represent strategy or technology consulting postings.; Case-interview round structure is labeled reported from secondary prep guides because Deloitte's official pages checked document the behavioral interview in detail but do not publish a universal stage list.; No population data - the wider-funnel claim is structural (posting architecture and per-role bars), not a measured acceptance-rate comparison with MBB.. We see who got in, not who tried and failed — survivorship bias is real (§0).

What Deloitte Consulting says it screens for vs what the record shows:
Stated: Behavioral evidence of achievement, communication, leadership/teaming and aptitude, structured with the STAR method, per Deloitte's official guidance. The plan:
Next thirty days:
- Confirm this cycle's application window and deadlines for Deloitte Consulting on the official careers page — dates move, and this CIR's cadence fact is the starting point, not the truth (§3.3). (by 2026-10-19)
- Apply to a first, reachable rung: a smaller employer in the same role family (the ladder pattern in this CIR's path patterns). Volume plus follow-up is the play. (by 2026-10-26)
- Ship the first version of one real project and write it up publicly. (by 2026-11-11)
- Build the coffee-chat target list from this CIR's entry routes: recent hires in the same role family, alumni of your school, people one rung up the ladder. (by 2026-10-22)
This semester:

- Run the coffee-chat list: short, specific asks; every conversation ends with a follow-up you actually send.

- If the direct route misses, take the highest adjacent rung this CIR names and re-aim with a year of signal (the risks-and-alternatives route in this thesis).

Coffee-chat strategy: target the profile types named in the ranked routes — recent hires in this role family, alumni of your school now inside, and people one rung up the ladder you are climbing. Ask what the interviews actually test, what surprised them after starting, and what they would do with a semester to prepare. Keep asks short and specific; send the follow-up you promised.

Timeline and key dates: No single national deadline was found: entry hiring runs through individual postings across the year, with campus internship cycles concentrated in the fall for the following summer (fall timing labeled reported from secondary guides; the official pages checked publish per-role details rather than a national calendar). (as of 2026-10-12; recruiting dates shift every cycle — re-check the official careers page before acting, §3.3).

Risks and alternatives: Do not quote the $67,500-$70,500 delivery-analyst range as 'Deloitte Consulting pay' - it is one government-delivery role's disclosed range, and strategy/technology consulting postings carry their own terms. There is no single deadline to diarise: missing a specific posting's close date is the failure mode, so the portal must be checked per service line and location. Process stage lists circulating online vary by office and service line; only the behavioral interview is documented on the official pages checked here. Adjacent options with similar signal: the other employers and role families whose CIRs share this ladder — the first rung matters more than the logo on it.

Want me to execute? I can build the coffee-chat target list from these routes, tailor your resume to this record's revealed screens (truthfully — only what you have actually done), and set the plan's reminders. Say the word and I start with the list.
